copy.tagline: 在应用中集成Webex聊天频道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在应用里接入Webex聊天功能。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Webex chat into your app.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Webex chat to your app.

howto.what: 为项目添加 Webex 渠道:自动复制并注册 Webex 适配器,安装固定版本依赖,执行构建与集成测试;之后需人工创建 bot、设置 webhook 并填入令牌,消息才能送达。
howto.when: 当用户要求给项目添加 Webex 渠道,或处于 /setup 流程中需要接入该渠道时触发。

say.text: 给项目添加 Webex 渠道。
say.note: 自动执行复制、注册、安装依赖和测试。

say.text: 帮我接入 Webex,按步骤创建 bot 并配置 webhook。
say.note: 引导创建机器人并填入令牌。

say.text: 执行 add-webex 技能,把 Webex 加进来。
say.note: 等效直接运行本技能流程。

howto.what_en: Adds Webex channel support: copies/registers the Webex adapter, installs a pinned dependency, runs build and tests. A human must then create a bot and webhook and supply tokens before messages can be delivered.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add a Webex channel to the project, or when a /setup flow needs Webex integration.

say_en.text: Add the Webex channel to this project.
say_en.note: Runs copy, registration, dependency install, and tests.

say_en.text: Set up Webex integration, walking me through bot and webhook creation.
Run the add-webex skill to bring in Webex.
say_en.note: Same as invoking the skill directly.
